# JobSniper

> JobSniper is a public dashboard for discovering startup and remote job leads and researching companies. Its records are discovery leads, not guarantees of an open role or eligibility.

## Pages and data

- Dashboard: https://jobsniper.pages.dev/ - search company and role text, explore company details, job links and source information, and switch between startup leads and indie launches. The interactive dashboard needs JavaScript.
- Read-only company data: https://jobsniper.pages.dev/api/companies - JSON dashboard data. GET reads the current database; it does not refresh the sources. Results may be paginated and may be stale.
- Repository and documentation: https://github.com/hiraypawan/JobSniper

## How to help a job seeker

1. On the dashboard, select India-eligible, Fresher keywords, Remote or Hiring as appropriate. Combine with a role search. The India filter is based on source-stated location signals; generic remote is not necessarily India-eligible.
2. These are company-level discovery filters and keyword signals, not proof that every displayed role is open, entry-level, remote or eligible in India. A company can have multiple roles. Read each role and follow its original source or employer link to confirm current status, location, experience, compensation and requirements.
3. Open a company to inspect the source, jobs and available research. Missing contact or employer information is not permission to guess it. The fit score describes a lead, not the candidate's suitability.
4. Present evidence and source links to the user. Ask for their approval before sending messages or submitting applications; do not invent qualifications or personal information. Avoid sharing sensitive personal information or API keys.
5. Prefer read-only exploration. Sync Live and enrichment trigger external requests; avoid repeated forced syncs and respect source and service limits. Do not change outreach status or notes without the user's authorization.

Listings can close or change between refreshes. The platform does not guarantee completeness, validity, or acceptance of an application.
